description: On Friday, the 30th Chinese medical team to Tunisia offered the final session of this year's Sanfutie, or Sanfu plaster therapy, to locals.
title: Chinese medical team brings TCM therapy to Tunisia

author: New China TV
description: "More than 80 years have passed, and only now are we beginning to realize how much Japan still hasn't told us," said Lim Shao Bin, a Singaporean historian who has spent decades tracing Japan's biological warfare activities in Southeast Asia, including Singapore, Malaysia and beyond. #Unit9420 #Unit731 #WWII #Japan #BiologicalWarfare
title: Uncovering Unit 731's dark history requires broader int'l cooperation, says Singaporean historian

author: New China TV
description:
China is moving beyond its role as a global manufacturing hub to become a source of technology capabilities and innovation.
From AI and electric vehicle batteries to automotive software, Chinese technology is reshaping global industries through scale, supply-chain depth and speed of innovation.
title: Trendy China | China Tech Goes Global: From Manufacturing Powerhouse to Innovation Source

author: New China TV
description: Newly acquired historical materials have provided new evidence of the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, said The Memorial Hall of the Victims of the Nanjing Massacre by Japanese Invaders in east China's Jiangsu on Saturday, the 81st anniversary of Japan's surrender in World War II. #GLOBALink #NanjingMassacre
title: Fresh evidence of Nanjing Massacre donated to Chinese memorial hall

author: New China TV
description: Seven wild Asian elephants turned a cornfield into their bedroom. According to local wildlife monitors, elephant herds usually leave a couple of members on guard. None stayed awake to keep watch -- a rare sign that showed they felt completely safe in their surroundings. #Elephants #Wildlife #Nature #China #AnimalTok
title: Seven Asian elephants sleep soundly in cornfield in SW China

author: New China TV
description: China won three gold medals and one silver medal to top team standings at the 38th International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI 2026) in the Uzbek capital of Tashkent. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | China wins 3 golds, 1 silver at informatics Olympiad

author: New China TV
description:
Our reporter hit the streets of Beijing with a China Travel Bingo Challenge for international visitors and came up with 9 daily experiences that they might encounter.
From everyday surprises to unexpected moments, come see what #ChinaTravel really feels like through their eyes
title: What makes China Travel so "cool" for global tourists?

author: New China TV
description: Displaced Gazans in overcrowded camps are now battling a surge in skin diseases amid sewage-filled swamps, piled-up garbage, and acute shortages of water and hygiene supplies. #Gaza #diseases #humanitarian
title: Amid sewage swamps and dilapidated tents, displaced Gazans besieged by skin diseases

author: New China TV
description:
More than 20 years ago, the Fenhe River was black and foul-smelling. Today, its cleaner waters and restored habitats are attracting more birds.
Meet 69-year-old Gao Qiusheng, known locally as "Uncle Bird," who has recorded more than 180 wild bird species along the river and witnessed its transformation firsthand.
title: I've photographed 180+ bird species as Fenhe River came back to life

author: New China TV
description: Many migratory birds depend on China's wetlands, Asia's largest and 4th largest worldwide by area, as vital stopovers along the world's busiest flyway. These habitats not only foster biodiversity but also serve as a regional hub for conservation training and cross-border cooperation across the Asia-Pacific region. #WetlandConservation #NatureProtection #GLOBALink
title: GLOBALink | China's wetlands set model for regional migratory bird conservation, cooperation

author: New China TV
description: China sent a new batch of internet satellites into orbit Sunday from a commercial spacecraft launch site in the southern island province of Hainan. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | China's Long March-12 rocket launches new internet satellite group

author: New China TV
description: The death toll from the recent magnitude-7.4 earthquake in Colombia rose to 294 on Saturday, with 3,935 people injured, 320 missing and 353 rescued, according to the National Unit for Disaster Risk Management (UNGRD). #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Colombia quake death toll rises to 294

author: New China TV
description: Twelve people were killed and at least 10 others injured after a Polish bus was involved in an accident in Hungary, Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar said on Sunday. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | 12 killed, 10 injured in bus accident in Hungary, says PM

author: New China TV
description: When Liang Kaiyu lost most of his left leg in an accident at 28, he had to learn how to walk all over again. But instead of letting the amputation define him, he began modifying his own prosthetic limbs -- creating new ways to move, work and even swim. Now, he is using what he has learned to help other people living with limb loss.
title: Mini Documentary | After losing his leg, he built a new way forward

author: New China TV
description:
China's homegrown #C919 completed its first scheduled international commercial flight this week, flying from Beijing to Ulan Bator, Mongolia.
The flight marked another milestone for the aircraft. Since entering commercial service in May 2023, the C919 has logged more than 130,000 safe flight hours.
title: China's C919 reaches new milestone with 1st overseas commercial flight

author: New China TV
description: The China-Europe Arctic container express route entered regular weekly operations for the summer season on Saturday, opening a faster and more resilient logistics link between China and Europe. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | China-Europe Arctic shipping route enters regular weekly operation

author: New China TV
description: A record-breaking wildfire in eastern Belgium had scorched about 2,700 hectares in the High Fens area by Saturday evening, forcing around 600 residents to evacuate, according to local authorities and media reports. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Belgium battles record wildfire as villages evacuated

author: New China TV
description: How many different landscapes can one #hiking trail reveal? When the rest of the country is sizzling under a heatwave, there's one place in Gansu where you need a jacket in August. At Binggou River Scenic Area in northwest China, visitors can follow mountain streams, walk through forests and grasslands, and discover clues to the geological history of the #QilianMountains along the way. Come with us for a cool summer hike in #Tianzhu.#TravelChina
title: Adventures Along the Silk Road | How many landscapes can you discover on one summer hike?

author: New China TV
description: The future of logistics is taking shape in Guangzhou, south China. China Post's Guangzhou Mail Processing Center has deployed embodied AI robots capable of sorting up to 1,200 parcels an hour, using multimodal perception and autonomous decision-making to handle package loading and identify irregular items. The center processes around 6.5 million mail items a day, with peak daily volumes exceeding 10 million. #AI #Robots #Logistics  #Technology
title: China's AI Robots Sort Up to 1,200 Parcels an Hour
